The impact spans 45,000 users and a 63‑minute outage, indicating a non‑trivial blast radius. Resolving such an issue typically requires coordination with DNS providers, verification of VPC DNS settings, and possible fallback mechanisms, placing the operational effort at a moderate level of complexity.
